visual_thesis: Trace-derived candidate instruction and tool-description changes must be evaluated and reviewed before promotion, with production-affecting tools isolated.
mechanism_metaphor: A diagonal overlapping stack climbs from lower left trace records to upper right review. The trace front sheet bears two genuinely informative states Success and Failure, not paragraph strokes. Above it lift two distinct candidate leaves Instructions and Tool descriptions with unmarked smooth surfaces except those exact labels. A single arrow from the trace object reaches the candidate leaf pair, and a second arrow from candidates reaches the separate Isolated evaluation object at upper right. Review before promotion is a physical closed threshold above that object, without an arrow through it. Public preview is detached upper left. Every shown relation is limited to prompt agents; no automatic live-agent mutation. No horizontal stations, cream plaques, ribbon or generic dashboard.
